'''{{PAGENAME}}s''' are forageable items located in all outdoor locations on the [[Locations|map]]. The closest location to the [[Sweet Home]] is to the south west in the small grove of trees. They can be consumed, which restores {{energy|+|5}} at the cost of {{health|-|1}}, or used as in ingredient in [[cooking]].
